/**
 * Request ID Middleware for Hono.
 *
 * @param {object} options - Options for Request ID middleware.
 * @param {number} [options.limitLength=255] - The maximum length of request id.
 * @param {string} [options.headerName=X-Request-Id] - The header name used in request id.
 * @param {generator} [options.generator=() => crypto.randomUUID()] - The request id generation function.
 * @param {boolean} [options.trustIncoming=true] - Whether to trust an incoming request id header. When `false`, any incoming value is ignored and the generator is always used.
 *
 * @returns {MiddlewareHandler} The middleware handler function.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * type Variables = RequestIdVariables
 * const app = new Hono<{Variables: Variables}>()
 *
 * app.use(requestId())
 * app.get('/', (c) => {
 *   console.log(c.get('requestId')) // Debug
 *   return c.text('Hello World!')
 * })
 * ```
 */
export const requestId = ({
  limitLength = 255,
  headerName = 'X-Request-Id',
  generator = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
  trustIncoming = true,
}: RequestIdOptions = {}): MiddlewareHandler => {
  return async function requestId(c, next) {
    // If `headerName` is empty string, req.header will return the object
    let reqId = trustIncoming && headerName ? c.req.header(headerName) : undefined
    if (!reqId || reqId.length > limitLength || /[^\w\-=]/.test(reqId)) {
      reqId = generator(c)
    }

    c.set('requestId', reqId)
    if (headerName) {
      c.header(headerName, reqId)
    }
    await next()

Done. `trustIncoming` is implemented and verified.

## Changes

**`src/middleware/request-id/request-id.ts`**
- Added `trustIncoming?: boolean` to `RequestIdOptions` and documented it as defaulting to `true`.
- Destructured `trustIncoming = true` in the middleware factory.
- Incoming header is now only read when `trustIncoming && headerName` is truthy; otherwise `reqId` starts `undefined` and the generator produces the value. Validation (`limitLength`, character whitelist) and the `c.set`/`c.header` exposure paths are unchanged, so the generated value is still exposed both ways.

**`src/middleware/request-id/index.test.ts`**
- New `trustIncoming` describe block with a deterministic generator and 4 tests:
  - `true` trusts the incoming header.
  - Omitted option behaves like `true` (default preserved).
  - `false` ignores an incoming header and uses the generator.
  - `false` with no header uses the generator.
